```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
con = DBI::dbConnect(
  RSQLite::SQLite(),
  "../data/midwest_airbnb_extended.db"
)

listings = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "listings") |>
  tibble::as_tibble()

availability = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "availability_monthly") |>
  tibble::as_tibble()

reviews = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "reviews_monthly") |>
  tibble::as_tibble()

DBI::dbDisconnect(con)
```


# Task 1
```{r}
host_counts = listings |>
  dplyr::count(host_id, name = "host_listings")

host_counts |>
  dplyr::filter(host_listings >= 10) |>
  dplyr::summarize(hosts_10_plus = dplyr::n())

listings_hosts = listings |>
  dplyr::left_join(host_counts, by = "host_id")

listings_hosts |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Chicago") |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    percent = 100 * mean(host_listings >= 10)
  )
```


# Task 2
```{r}
family_homes = listings |>
  dplyr::filter(
    room_type == "Entire home/apt",
    accommodates >= 4,
    number_of_reviews >= 10,
    review_scores_rating >= 4.8
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    price_per_person = price / accommodates
  )

family_neighborhoods = family_homes |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, neighbourhood) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    median_price_per_person = median(price_per_person, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(n >= 20)

family_neighborhoods |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Columbus") |>
  dplyr::arrange(median_price_per_person)
```


# Task 3
```{r}
earnings = listings |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, room_type) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    dplyr::across(
      c(price, reviews_per_month, estimated_revenue_l365d),
      ~ median(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

earnings |>
  dplyr::filter(
    city == "Twin Cities",
    room_type == "Entire home/apt"
  )
```


# Task 4
```{r}
revenue_ranked = listings |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    dplyr::desc(estimated_revenue_l365d),
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    rank = dplyr::row_number(),
    cutoff = ceiling(0.10 * dplyr::n()),
    top_10 = rank <= cutoff
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

revenue_share = revenue_ranked |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    top_10_revenue = sum(estimated_revenue_l365d[top_10], na.rm = TRUE),
    total_revenue = sum(estimated_revenue_l365d, na.rm = TRUE),
    percent = 100 * top_10_revenue / total_revenue,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

revenue_share
```


# Task 5
```{r}
october = availability |>
  dplyr::filter(month == "2026-10")

entire_homes = listings |>
  dplyr::filter(room_type == "Entire home/apt")

october_homes = entire_homes |>
  dplyr::inner_join(october, by = "id") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    mostly_taken = nights_available < 0.5 * nights_in_month
  )

october_homes |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    share = 100 * mean(mostly_taken),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(share)
```


# Task 6
```{r}
monthly_demand = reviews |>
  dplyr::inner_join(
    listings |>
      dplyr::select(id, city),
    by = "id"
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    month >= "2025-07",
    month <= "2026-06"
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, month) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    total_reviews = sum(reviews, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

twin_demand = monthly_demand |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Twin Cities") |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(total_reviews))

twin_demand

twin_demand |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    ratio = max(total_reviews) / min(total_reviews)
  )
```


# Task 7
```{r}
superhost = listings |>
  dplyr::filter(
    room_type == "Entire home/apt",
    !is.na(host_is_superhost),
    host_is_superhost %in% c("t", "f")
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, host_is_superhost) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    median_price = median(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_rating = median(review_scores_rating, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

superhost

superhost_premium = superhost |>
  dplyr::select(city, host_is_superhost, median_price) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = host_is_superhost,
    values_from = median_price
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    premium = t - f
  )

superhost_premium
```


# Task 8
```{r}
missing_availability = listings |>
  dplyr::anti_join(
    availability,
    by = "id"
  )

missing_availability |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    missing = dplyr::n()
  )

missing_availability |>
  dplyr::count(city) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n))
```
